<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.2</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>PROMISSORY NOTE</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">THIS UNSECURED PROMISSORY
NOTE (THIS &ldquo;<B><I>NOTE</I></B>&rdquo;) HAS NOT BEEN REGISTERED UNDER ANY STATE SECURITIES LAWS OR UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OF 1933,
AS AMENDED (THE &ldquo;<B><I>SECURITIES ACT</I></B>&rdquo;),&nbsp;IN RELIANCE UPON VARIOUS EXEMPTIONS THEREFROM. THIS NOTE HAS BEEN ACQUIRED
FOR INVESTMENT FOR THE REGISTERED HOLDER&rsquo;S OWN ACCOUNT AND NOT WITH A VIEW TO, OR IN CONNECTION WITH, THE SALE, TRANSFER OR OTHER
DISTRIBUTION HEREOF. NO SUCH SALE, TRANSFER OR OTHER DISPOSITION MAY&nbsp;BE EFFECTED, NOR WILL ANY ASSIGNEE OR TRANSFEREE THEREOF BE
RECOGNIZED BY THE BORROWER, WITHOUT AN EFFECTIVE REGISTRATION STATEMENT RELATED THERETO OR THE DETERMINATION BY THE BORROWER,&nbsp;IN
ITS SOLE DISCRETION, THAT SUCH REGISTRATION IS NOT REQUIRED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT, OR UNDER ANY APPLICABLE STATE OR OTHER SECURITIES
LAWS OR OTHER APPLICABLE LAWS OF SIMILAR IMPORT.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">THIS NOTE IS ONE OF A SERIES
OF PROMISSORY NOTES BEING ISSUED BY THE BORROWER, EACH OF WHICH NOTES IS IDENTICAL EXCEPT FOR ONE OR MORE OF THE IDENTITY OF THE LENDER
THEREUNDER OR ANY REGISTERED HOLDER THEREOF, THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF EACH SUCH PROMISSORY NOTE AND THE DATE OF ISSUANCE. THE LENDER AND
ANY REGISTERED HOLDER, BY ITS ACCEPTANCE OF THIS NOTE, ACKNOWLEDGES AND AGREES THAT THE ACCELERATION OF THE MATURITY DATE UPON THE OCCURRENCE
OF AN EVENT OF DEFAULT AND ANY AMENDMENT OF THE TERMS AND PROVISIONS OF THIS NOTE ARE SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF LENDERS AND REGISTERED
HOLDERS HOLDING IN THE AGGREGATE MORE THAN 50% OF THE OUTSTANDING PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF THE PROMISSORY NOTES COMPRISING THE SERIES OF WHICH
THIS NOTE IS A PART.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 50%; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">IN&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF U.S. $1,000.00</FONT></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: right; width: 50%">Dated:
[<FONT STYLE="background-color: yellow"><B>CLOSING DATE</B></FONT>], 2026</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">FOR VALUE RECEIVED, Monroe
Capital ABF Onshore Intermediate Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, Monroe Capital ABF Offshore Intermediate Holdings,
LP, a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership and Monroe Capital ABF REIT Intermediate Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability
company, individually and collectively, as the context may require, the &ldquo;<B><I>Borrower</I></B>&rdquo;) HEREBY PROMISE TO PAY to
[<FONT STYLE="background-color: yellow"><B>NAME OF INVESTOR</B></FONT>] (the &ldquo;<B><I>Lender</I></B>&rdquo;) the principal amount
of U.S. $1,000.00 on [<FONT STYLE="background-color: yellow"><B>&#9679;</B></FONT>], 2056 (the &ldquo;<B><I>Maturity Date</I></B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Borrower promises to pay
interest on the sum of the unpaid principal amount of $1,000.00 plus any past due but unpaid interest hereunder, from the date hereof
until such amount is paid in full, at the rate of 12% per annum (except as provided below upon the occurrence and during the continuance
of an Event of Default), payable in arrears on June&nbsp;30 and December&nbsp;31 of each calendar year beginning on December&nbsp;31,
2026, and if such day is not a Business Day, then on the immediately preceding Business Day (subject to and as more particularly provided
in <U>Sections 1.01</U> and <U>1.02</U> hereof), and on the date on which the principal amount of this Note, plus any accrued but unpaid
interest, is paid in full. The term &ldquo;<B><I>Business Day</I></B>&rdquo; means a day of the year on which banks are not required or
authorized to close in New York City.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Because the Borrower consists
of more than one entity, liability to the Lender for the fulfillment of all obligations of any Borrower hereunder shall be joint and several
in all respects among the other entities consisting of the Borrower hereunder, and the compromise of any claim with, or the release of,
any Borrower shall not constitute a compromise with, or a release of, any other Borrower.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Upon payment in full of the
principal hereof and accrued interest hereunder, this Note shall be surrendered to the Borrower for cancellation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B>Article&nbsp;I</B></FONT><B><BR>
TERMS OF PAYMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;1.01.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Prepayments; Prepayment Premium</I></B><I>.</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">At any time on or following
the date on which Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP - Series&nbsp;II (&ldquo;<B><I>Series&nbsp;II</I></B>&rdquo;), a registered
series of Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP, a Delaware series limited partnership (the &ldquo;<B><I>Partnership</I></B>&rdquo;)
has redeemed the Share (as defined below), the Borrower may upon written notice to the Lender, which notice will indicate the proposed
date and the principal amount to be prepaid, prepay in whole or in part the outstanding principal amount of this Note at any time, <I>provided
</I>that (i)&nbsp;the Borrower will pay on the Redemption Proceeds Date (as defined below) all accrued and unpaid interest due through
and including the date on which REIT Administration, LLC, in its capacity as the agent to the Lender hereunder, receives payment for the
Standard Fee Class-I Share of Series&nbsp;II of the Partnership&rsquo;s limited partnership interest held by such Lender (the&nbsp;&ldquo;<B><I>Share</I></B>&rdquo;)
redeemed pursuant to the Purchase Agreement (as defined below) (the &ldquo;<B><I>Redemption Proceeds Date</I></B>&rdquo;) on the principal
amount being prepaid, and (ii)&nbsp;if the first such prepayment occurs prior to the second anniversary of the issue date of this Note,
the Borrower will also pay on the date of such prepayment a one-time premium equal to U.S. $100.00 on this Note (the &ldquo;<B><I>Prepayment
Premium</I></B>&rdquo;) on the date of such prepayment. By signing the Purchase Agreement governing the purchase of this Note (the&nbsp;&ldquo;<B><I>Purchase
Agreement</I></B>&rdquo;), upon any such prepayment and pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, the Lender agrees to submit or cause to be
submitted the outstanding Share held by such Lender for redemption.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;1.02.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Payments and Computations.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Borrower will make each
payment hereunder not later than 4:00 pm (Eastern time) on the day when due in U.S. dollars to the Lender at its address referred to in
<U>Section&nbsp;3.02</U> or via electronic payment in same day funds. All computations of interest will be made by the Lender on the basis
of a year of 360 days, consisting of twelve (12) thirty (30) day months, for the number of days occurring in the period for which such
interest is payable. Whenever any payment hereunder is stated to be due on a day other than a Business Day, such payment will be made
on the immediately preceding Business Day, with the same legal force and effect as if made on the actual due date.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 2; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->3<!-- Field: /Sequence -->S</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;1.03.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Registration.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">This Note is issued in registered
form as to both principal and interest. The Borrower or its agent will maintain a register (the &ldquo;<B><I>Register</I></B>&rdquo;)
for the recordation of the name and address of any holder of this Note (the &ldquo;<B><I>Registered Holder</I></B>&rdquo;). The Lender
will be the initial Registered Holder. All interest on, and the principal of, this Note will only be paid to the Registered Holder. If
a Registered Holder shall transfer and assign this Note in accordance with the restrictions on transfer described on the first page&nbsp;hereof,
the Registered Holder shall provide or cause to be provided written notice to the Borrower and the Borrower or its agent will note the
transfer and assignment appropriately on the Register, which shall identify such transferee and assignee as the new Registered Holder.
The Register shall be similarly updated to reflect any subsequent transfers permitted under this <U>Section&nbsp;1.03</U> by a Registered
Holder to a different Registered Holder. A holder of this Note (including any Registered Holder) does not have the right to convert this
Note to bearer form.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;1.04.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Evidence of Exemption from U.S. Withholding Tax</I></B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Lender shall deliver to
the Borrower, on or prior to the date hereof, and any prospective Registered Holder shall deliver to the Borrower on or prior to the date
on which it acquires the Lender&rsquo;s or any other Registered Holder&rsquo;s interest in this Note, and at such other times as may be
necessary in the determination of the Borrower, the Lender or any Registered Holder (each in the reasonable exercise of its discretion),
an accurate and complete original signed copy of a Form&nbsp;W-9, substitute Form&nbsp;W-9 or any successor form prescribed by the Internal
Revenue Service, together with any other certificates or statements of exemption required under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as
amended, or the regulations issued thereunder, to establish that no deduction or withholding of U.S. taxes is required with respect to
any amounts payable hereunder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;1.05.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Notes Comprising a Series.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Lender and each Registered
Holder acknowledges and agrees that this Note is one of a series of promissory notes (the &ldquo;<B><I>Series</I></B>&rdquo;) issued by
the Borrower, each of which promissory notes is identical except for one or more of the identity of the lender thereunder or any Registered
Holder thereof. The Lender and each Registered Holder, by its acceptance of this Note, acknowledges and agrees that the rights that it
may exercise upon the occurrence of an Event of Default (as defined below) and any amendment of the terms and provisions of this Note
are subject to the approval of holders of promissory notes of the Series, the aggregate outstanding principal amount of which represents
more than 50% of the aggregate outstanding principal amount of all of the promissory notes comprising the Series.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B>Article&nbsp;II</B></FONT><B><BR>
EVENTS OF DEFAULT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;2.01.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Events of Default</I></B><I>.</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">The following events shall each constitute an &ldquo;<B><I>Event
of Default</I></B>&rdquo;:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(a)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Borrower fails to pay the principal of this Note when the same becomes due and payable; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(b)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Borrower fails to pay any interest on this Note when the same becomes due and payable within three Business Days after the same becomes
due; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 3; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->4<!-- Field: /Sequence -->S</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(c)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Borrower is insolvent or otherwise is unable to pay its debts as such debts become due, or admits in writing its inability to pay such
debts generally, or makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors; or a proceeding is instituted by or against the Borrower
or any of its subsidiaries seeking to adjudicate it bankrupt or insolvent, or seeking liquidation, winding up, reorganization, arrangement,
adjustment, protection, relief, or composition of it or its debts under any law relating to bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization or
relief of debtors, or seeking the entry of an order for relief or the appointment of a receiver, trustee, custodian or other similar official
for it or for any substantial part of its property and, in the case of any such proceeding instituted against it (but not instituted by
it), either such proceeding remains undismissed for a period of 60 days, or any of the actions sought in such proceeding (including, without
limitation, the entry of an order for relief against, or the appointment of a receiver, trustee, custodian or other similar official for,
it or for any substantial part of its property) occurs; or the Borrower or any of its subsidiaries takes any organizational action to
authorize any of the actions set forth above in this <U>Section&nbsp;2.01(c)</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.75in">As used in this Section&nbsp;2.01(c),
the term &ldquo;subsidiaries&rdquo; does not include any &ldquo;Portfolio Entity&rdquo;, defined to mean any operating entity owned, directly
or indirectly through subsidiaries, by the Partnership, Series&nbsp;II, the Borrower or &ldquo;Monroe Clients&rdquo; (as defined below)
for operational or profit purposes, including, as the context requires, portfolio companies, holding companies, special purpose vehicles
and other entities through which the Partnership, Series&nbsp;II and the Borrower holds assets. &ldquo;Monroe Clients&rdquo; means, as
the context requires, individually and collectively, any of the following: investment funds, vehicles, accounts, entities, products and
/or similar arrangements, other than the Partnership, Series&nbsp;II, the Borrower, and their subsidiaries, sponsored, advised and/or
managed by Monroe Capital Asset Finance Advisors, LLC (&ldquo;<B><I>Monroe</I></B>&rdquo;) or its affiliates, whether currently in existence
or subsequently established (in each case, including any related successor funds, alternative vehicles, supplemental capital vehicles,
surge funds, over-flow funds, co-investment vehicles and other entities formed in connection with Monroe&rsquo;s or its&rsquo; affiliates
side-by-side or additional general partner investments with respect thereto).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;2.02.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Remedies Upon Events of Default</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">Upon the occurrence and during
the continuance of any Event of Default, a Registered Holder may notify the Borrower of such Event of Default, after which time the Borrower
shall have 30 days to cure such Event of Default. If an Event of Default continues after such 30-day period, the holders of promissory
notes of the Series, the aggregate outstanding principal amount of which represents more than 50% of the aggregate outstanding principal
amount of all of the promissory notes comprising the Series&nbsp;(such holders being the &ldquo;<B><I>Required Holders</I></B>&rdquo;)
may, upon notice to the Borrower, declare all of the promissory notes comprising the Series&nbsp;(including this Note), and all interest
thereon to be forthwith due and payable, without presentment, demand, protest or further notice of any kind, all of which are hereby expressly
waived by the Borrower, provided, however, that if such Event of Default is an Event of Default pursuant to <U>Section&nbsp;2.01(c)</U>,
all of the notes comprising the Series&nbsp;(including this Note) and all interest thereon, shall automatically become and be due and
payable, without presentment, demand, protest or any notice of any kind, all of which are hereby expressly waived by the Borrower.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B>Article&nbsp;III</B></FONT><B><BR>
MISCELLANEOUS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;3.01.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Amendments, Etc.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">No amendment or waiver of
any provision of this Note, nor consent to any departure by the Borrower herefrom, will be effective unless the same is in writing and
signed by the Required Holders and the Borrower, and then such waiver or consent will be effective only in the specific instance and for
the specific purpose for which given, <I>provided, however</I>, that no such amendment, waiver or consent may reduce the principal amount
hereof or the rate of interest payable hereunder, or delay the date on which any amount of interest or principal is due and payable hereunder,
unless the Registered Holder shall have agreed to such amendment, waiver or consent.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;3.02.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Notices, Etc.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">All notices and other communications
provided for hereunder will be in writing and mailed or delivered via nationally recognized overnight courier or by electronic mail, if
to the Lender or the Borrower, at their respective addresses set forth on the signature page&nbsp;hereof; or, if to a Registered Holder,
in such holder&rsquo;s name, c/o REIT Administration, LLC at 1175 Peachtree Street, N.E., Suite&nbsp;2200, Atlanta, Georgia 30361, admin@reit-funding.com,
or at such other address as shall be designated by such Registered Holder for use in the Register maintained hereunder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;3.03.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>No Waiver; Remedies.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">No failure on the part of
the Lender to exercise, and no delay in exercising, any right hereunder will operate as a waiver thereof; nor will any single or partial
exercise of any right hereunder preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right. The remedies herein
provided are cumulative and not exclusive of any remedies provided by law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;3.04.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Binding Effect.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">This Note will be binding
upon and inure to the benefit of the Borrower and the Lender and their respective successors and assigns, subject to the restrictions
on transfer described on the first page&nbsp;of this Note and except that neither the Borrower nor the Lender may assign its rights hereunder
or any interest herein without the other&rsquo;s prior written consent; provided that no such consent shall be required for any assignment
or transfer made as a result of the death of the Lender.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;3.05.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Consent to Jurisdiction.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(a)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>The
Borrower hereby irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware and any appellate
court thereof in any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Note, and the Borrower hereby irrevocably agrees that all
claims in respect of such action or proceeding may be heard and determined in such court. The Borrower hereby irrevocably waives, to the
fullest extent it may effectively do so, the defense of an inconvenient forum to the maintenance of such action or proceeding. The Borrower
consents to the service of any and all process in any such action or proceeding by the mailing of copies of such process to the Borrower
at its address specified in <U>Section&nbsp;3.02</U>. The Borrower agrees that a final judgment in any such action or proceeding will
be conclusive and may be enforced in other jurisdictions by suit on the judgment or in any other manner provided by law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(b)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</FONT>Nothing
in this <U>Section&nbsp;3.05</U> will affect the right of the Lender to serve legal process in any other manner permitted by law or affect
the right of the Lender to bring any action or proceeding against the Borrower or its property in the courts of any other jurisdiction.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;3.06.
</I></B></FONT>Governing Law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">This Note will be governed
by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of Delaware, United States.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;3.07.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Tax Treatment.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Borrower (and its affiliates)
and Lender will each treat this Note and amounts borrowed thereunder as debt and the relationship between the Borrower and Lender are
that of debtor and creditor, in each case for all U.S. federal, state and local tax purposes and will report consistently with such intent.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase"><B><I>Section&nbsp;3.08.
</I></B></FONT><B><I>Electronic Signatures.</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Lender agrees that any
.PDF, facsimile or other reproduction of its signature on this Note will be deemed to have the same validity, admissibility, enforceability
and legal effect as delivery of an original, manually executed copy of this Note for all purposes.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><I>[The remainder of this page&nbsp;intentionally
left blank.]</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
